title.zh: Vitalik提出EIP-8288以STARK证明实现通用密码学支持，减少预编译合约需求
title.en: Vitalik: EIP-8288 Enables Arbitrary Signature Schemes, Ethereum May Never Need N

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin argues Ethereum should adopt EIP-8288, having clients perform complex cryptography and submit recursively aggregated STARK proofs so the chain only verifies results, keeping the chain lightweight and reducing the need for new precompile contracts.
current_state.en: Vitalik Buterin argues Ethereum should adopt EIP-8288, having clients perform complex cryptography and submit recursively aggregated STARK proofs so the chain only verifies results, keeping the chain lightweight and reducing the need for new precompile contracts.
